subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.8.1 Trainee will be able to explain principle of Synchroscope indication system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Demonstration of Synchroscope indication using PPT slides; Safety: Do not touch live electrical components; Instructor supervision: Monitor trainee understanding of phase alignment concepts.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a synchroscope in an aircraft electrical system?
How does a synchroscope assist in synchronizing AC generators?
What are the basic components of a synchroscope indication system?

What does a stationary needle indicate on a synchroscope?
